title: Feudal Gardens | A zen scuplter with progression and economy, oh and frogs.
author: Sad_Library123
selftext:
Lately it feels like the cozy builder space is filling up with one-for-one Tiny Glade clones literally carbon copies of the hud and everything, and nothing new to the formula.

[Feudal Gardens ](https://iconoclaststudios.itch.io/feudal-gardens)started as a college project between my wife and me, and we’re both gardeners in real life, so we wanted our garden to have a purpose instead of just sitting there looking nice for screenshots. Where AI made the biggest difference was the most complicated systems, the ones that let the world respond to you. Dig with the terrain brush and the ground fills with water once it drops below the water line. Draw a path and it works out for itself whether to become a bridge over a pond or steps up a terrace. Every resident is a frog with needs and a temperament who plans their own day. Working through those systems with AI is what turned a project limited by knowledge of java, and it pushed me further. Here is a PSX showcase [trailer](https://youtu.be/A7yuYiPZbU4?si=LlHqVnr_p2FON7mM)
